items.title: Pay invoice for electrical work
items.quote: Zahlbar innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 20.03.2026. The 14-day period is triggered by this date, so under §187 Abs.1 BGB the period begins on the following day, 21.03.2026. Counting 14 days from 20.03.2026 lands on 03.04.2026 (20+14=34; 34-31=3 April), the calculated last day of the period (§188 Abs.1 BGB). 03.04.2026 is Karfreitag (Good Friday, since Easter Sunday 2026 falls on 05.04.2026), a statutory public holiday in Nordrhein-Westfalen. The following days, 04.04. (Saturday), 05.04. (Sunday) and 06.04. (Ostermontag, also a public holiday in NW), are likewise non-business days. Per §193 BGB the deadline moves to the next business day, Tuesday, 07.04.2026.
